versions.name: Quick List
versions.description: Quickly add levels to your top list

about:
# Quick List

Trying to create large lists of levels that aren't easily searchable? Quick List can help! All search results have a new "quick-list" button that adds the level to your top created list.

Thanks to [imesss](user:36491794) ([ItMe12s](https://github.com/ItMe12s)) for creating the Luau API! You can check it out [here](https://github.com/ItMe12s/LuauAPI) to script your own mods easily :)
changelog:
## v0.1.2

- Fixes crash triggered by resource retaining
- Removes option for opening the "add to list" menu. The list overlaps the search results layer which looks bad, and I'm not sure there's a large enough appetite to justify the added complexity. If you would like this functionality back, please submit a feature request on Github.

### v0.1.1

- Fixes the account link in `about.md` for imesss

### v0.1.0

- Initial release
